title: fix(spec): a currency field's precision is total digits — stop refusing precision: 18 on a fixed-USD field (#20011)
body:
Fixes #20011
Clause-②: yes

`FieldSchema` stops comparing a currency field's field-level `precision` with the ISO 4217 fraction digits of its fixed currency. `precision: 18` on a fixed-USD field now parses. `currencyConfig.precision` is a different key, and its check is untouched.

## What was wrong (reproduced on `origin/main` `e4471e64`, before any edit)

`FieldSchema.safeParse` through the source, one field per row:

| input (`type: 'currency'`) | result on `e4471e64` |
|:--|:--|
| `precision: 18`, fixed USD | REFUSED at `['precision']` |
| `precision: 2`, fixed USD | accepted |
| `precision: 1`, fixed USD | REFUSED at `['precision']` |
| `precision: 18`, fixed JPY | REFUSED at `['precision']` |
| `precision: 0`, fixed JPY | accepted |
| `precision: 18`, dynamic | accepted |
| `precision: 18`, no `currencyConfig` | accepted |
| `type: 'number'`, `precision: 18` | accepted |

The refusal text for the first row, which this PR removes from the field-level path:

> currency USD has 2 fraction digits; `precision: 18` contradicts it — the amount would render minor-unit digits the currency does not have, or drop digits it does (ISO 4217 / CLDR currencyData). Declare `precision: 2`, or omit `precision` and let renderers derive the width from the currency. Codes outside CLDR (crypto/custom) are not checked, and a field in `dynamic` currencyMode has no single currency to check against.

The key is declared `precision: z.number().int().min(0).optional().describe('Total digits (non-negative integer)')`. A DECIMAL(18,2) amount is `precision: 18`, and the remedy asked for a total-digit count of 2. Ruling 乙 on #19910 (`5805782503`): 「## Ruled — 乙: a currency's decimal places are the currency's, not a setting」.

**Real producer:** objectui's Studio field designer offers a "Precision" control on every numeric type, currency included (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx:917-919` at the pin `f8a9d0fb`, `patchDef({ precision: v })`). An admin who types 18 on a fixed-USD currency field gets this refusal at save.

## The premise, re-measured (it is false everywhere)

The check's own comment named its premise: 「the FIELD-level `precision` key doubles as the currency display width — objectui's CurrencyField reads it」. Before removing it, every face was checked for a read of field-level `precision` as decimal places. None was found.

**objectui at the console pin `f8a9d0fb0596`** (`.objectui-sha` on `main`). `git grep -w precision` over non-test `packages/**` and `apps/**` `*.ts` / `*.tsx` gives 83 lines. Each one is one of these:

- **A comment or doc.** For example, `CurrencyField.tsx:64-78` says 「⛔ NOT the field-level `precision`」.
- **A type declaration.** `types/src/field-types.ts:407,436,446`.
- **A pass-through copy** into a metadata object: `ObjectGrid.tsx:2863,3084,3250`, `RelatedList.tsx:1607`, `RecordDetailPanel.tsx:167`, `sectionFields.ts:321`, `ObjectGallery.tsx:367`, `useColumnSummary.ts:492`.
- **The designer's write** above.
- **`formatPercent`'s own parameter** of that name. Its callers pass `scale`.

The faces that format numbers:

- `CurrencyField` derives its width from `currencyFractionDigits(currency)`.
- `CurrencyCellRenderer` calls `formatCurrency(num, currency, locale)` with no width argument.
- `NumberCellRenderer` and `PercentCellRenderer` read `scale`.
- The grid footer's currency arm calls `formatCurrency` and reads neither key.
- `ObjectMetricWidget` resolves only the currency.
- The detail chip reads `scale`.

**objectstack.** No `packages/**` source reads the field-level key. `NUMERIC_COLUMN_REPRESENTATION.currency` is a fixed `(65, 30)` column. `driver-sql/src/builtin-column-collision.ts:77` says `precision` is 「this driver does not read it yet」. objectql has no write-seam total-digit check.

So the check guarded a reading that no longer exists. What it still did was refuse the ruled contract.

## Decision: delete the check, keep no residual

Zone 2 of the dispatch asked whether some residual stays true, for example `precision` below the currency's fraction digits. Measured: **no numeric type has a total-digit coherence rule.** `{ type: 'number', precision: 1, scale: 2 }` parses on `main`, and so does `{ type: 'percent', precision: 0, scale: 3 }`. Four-axis reading:

- **Business need.** Nothing reads the key, so a residual guards the internal consistency of a value with no effect. The census below finds no authored producer in any of the three repos.
- **Long-term fit.** A total-digit coherence rule belongs next to a total-digit enforcement (DDL or the write seam), and neither exists. A currency-only, fixed-mode-only remnant would be the one such rule in the spec.
- **AI-authoring safety.** The mistake an AI plausibly makes is `precision: 2` meaning "decimals". Refusing that would narrow the accept set, which neither this card nor the dispatch authorizes; the dispatch requires that `precision: 2` keep parsing. The larger trap is that the key is inert everywhere. That goes to the seat as a finding (Acceptance notes), not a new rule here.
- **Startup focus.** A new refusal rule is a new gate, and the default is no.

A comment at the old site records why the comparison is absent, so it is not reinstated as an "improvement".

## Changes

- `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`: the field-level `currencyPrecisionContradiction` call inside `FieldSchema`'s `.superRefine` is deleted, and a comment replaces it. The import comment is updated. **Region fence:** hunks only at the import comment and the old anchor. There is no hunk in `CurrencyConfigSchema` (its `.superRefine` / `.overwrite` and the `precision` default, #19992's region), in `SelectOptionSchema`, or in the `requiredWhen` / `readonlyWhen` region.
- `packages/spec/src/data/currency-fraction-digits.ts`: doc comments only. The helper keeps both of its readers, in `CurrencyConfigSchema`'s `.superRefine` and `.overwrite`. The docblock no longer says "shared by BOTH anchors", and it now states that the verdict is ⛔ not for the field-level key. The message text is unchanged.
- `packages/spec/src/data/currency-precision-iso4217.test.ts`: the field-level block is rewritten (pins below). The header docblock is updated.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx` and `validation-rules.mdx`: both claimed a declared `precision` must agree with the currency. This PR makes that false for the field-level key, so the text now names `currencyConfig.precision`. It also says the field-level key is total digits and is never compared. New text in `field-types.mdx`:

  > A currency amount's decimal places are its currency's ISO 4217 minor unit (2 for USD, 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD), not a field setting, so a `currency` field takes no `scale`: publish-time validation refuses the key. The field-level `precision` is the amount's total digit count — a DECIMAL(18,2) amount declares `precision: 18` — and is never compared with the currency.

  The same section's table also listed `scale` ("Decimal places") as a currency property. That contradicts the new paragraph and the landed spec refusal (`field.zod.ts`, `scale` on `currency` is refused, with the same wording in `protocol/objectql/schema.mdx`), so the row is deleted.
- `.changeset/20011-currency-field-precision-total-digits.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. Nothing is narrowed, so there is no ADR-0087 entry (`check:adr-0087-registration` exit 0).

## Pins (`currency-precision-iso4217.test.ts`, block `#20011 — field-level precision is total digits…`)

- `precision: 18` on fixed USD parses, and `data.precision` is still 18.
- `precision: 2` on fixed USD still parses.
- **Flipped:** `precision: 2` on fixed JPY parses (DECIMAL(2,0)). This is the old `rejects … (JPY + 2)` pin.
- Total digits parse on every fraction-digit class: JPY 0 / 12, USD 2 / 18, KWD 3 / 2 / 15, each with the authored value carried through.
- No currency-only coherence rule: USD `precision: 1` parses, as `number` with `precision: 1, scale: 2` does.
- Outside fixed mode (no `currencyConfig`, dynamic authored or defaulted), nothing changes. Non-currency types are untouched.
- Through the object door: `ObjectSchema.create` with a fixed-USD `precision: 18` field, then `ObjectSchema.safeParse` of the JSON round-trip, succeeds and keeps 18.
- **Kept refusal (genuine, a different key):** `currencyConfig: { precision: 2, currencyMode: 'fixed', defaultCurrency: 'JPY' }` through `FieldSchema` is refused at `['currencyConfig', 'precision']`, code `custom`. The message contains `currency JPY has 0 fraction digits` and the prescription `Declare \`precision: 0\``.
- **Flipped:** the old `both anchors fire independently` pin. With both keys authored, exactly one issue is raised, at `['currencyConfig', 'precision']` (code + path + prescription asserted). The field-level key raises nothing.
- The `#7918` `currencyConfig`-level block, the `#11423` materialization block and the digit-table block are untouched and green.

**Pin sweep.** Searched for `fraction digits; ` and `contradicts it —` across objectstack, objectui at the pin, and cloud `48d70663`. The only field-level pins were in this test file. The other `currencyMode: 'fixed'` fixtures (`field.test.ts`, `field-currency-scale-refused.test.ts`, three `service-analytics` tests) carry no field-level `precision`.

## Reverse verification

Run on the committed fix `accdab16` with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` plus its own `trap` restore. The mutation re-inserts the old field-level check under a marker. The marker count was 0, then 1 during the run, then 0 after. The blob went `26f8ef39` → `5c392b24` and back to `26f8ef39`.

Expected direction: red. Observed: **6 failed, 24 passed**, and the six are exactly the new acceptance pins. Restore was proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`, not by an exit code.

The first attempt was a no-op. My replacement contained the anchor text, so the anchor count could not drop, and the tool refused it before running the test. It was redone with a replacement that drops the anchor. The later merge of `main` touched neither mutated file.

## Producer census (authored currency fields with a field-level `precision`)

The detector parses `Field.currency({…})` and `type: 'currency'` object literals and reads their top-level keys.

| tree | non-test currency declarations | with field-level `precision` | control (tests, same detector) |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| objectstack `e4471e64` (`examples/**`, `packages/**`) | 31 | 0 | 194 declarations, 2 hits (`object.test.ts:800` = 18, `lint-liveness-properties.test.ts:780` = 2) |
| objectui `f8a9d0fb` | 5 | 0 | 180 declarations, 14 hits |
| cloud `48d70663` | 0 | 0 | 44 declarations, 0 hits; no non-test field `precision` anywhere in `packages/**` |

The one live producer is the Studio designer control named above.

## Verification (final head `0e006877`, after merging `main` at `172b4cf3`)

- `@objectstack/spec` suite (`vitest run --project local`): **540 files, 15871 passed, 2 todo**.
- `@objectstack/spec` typecheck (`tsc --noEmit`, scripts, test layer): exit 0, and the test-layer debt ledger held.
- `check:generated`: all 15 generated artifacts up to date.
- Consumer suites: `@objectstack/lint` **108 files / 4183 passed**; `@objectstack/platform-objects` **55 / 911 passed**.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived **104** commands for these 6 paths. **All 104 exit 0 at `0e006877`**. `--ran` reconciliation: 104 derived, 104 run, 0 NOT MEASURED, a derived zero because every line recorded its exit code.
  - At the final head, one first run (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`) exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`). It was re-run to 0 once the packages it named were built.
  - The pre-merge pass at `accdab16` had seven such refusals, all cleared the same way.
  - None of those refusals counts as a measurement.
- ESLint, narrowed to the three touched `.ts` files:
  - All three resolve a config under `--print-config`.
  - `--format json` reports 3 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
  - `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (its own note at `:326-328`), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
  - `pnpm lint` over the whole repo is CI's run.
- NOT MEASURED locally, declared to CI:
  - Dogfood. No dogfood test pins currency `precision`.
  - The workspace, examples and downstream-contract type-check lanes.
  - The CI-only jobs these paths schedule.

## Acceptance notes

- **Finding for the seat (not filed here): the field-level `precision` key has no reader at all.** It is declared "Total digits (non-negative integer)" and the Studio designer writes it on every numeric type. Nothing enforces it: not DDL (fixed `(65, 30)`), not the write seam, and no display face. `packages/spec/liveness/field.json` `props.precision` still reads `live`, citing objectui `@11c1e71e` reads (`CurrencyField.tsx:45`, `PercentField.tsx:13`, `index.tsx:662`, `useColumnSummary.ts:261`), all of which are gone at `f8a9d0fb`. This is the same family as #19992, which covers `currencyConfig.precision` with no reader. Details are in the dev report on the card.
- #19992 (the `CurrencyConfigSchema.precision` anchor) is not addressed here and remains open. Its region is untouched.
